features: Introduces one global new-competitor registration path for Manual Scoring, Automatic Scoring and Scoring Tests
New competitors now receive an official BDC ID from the canonical bdc_competitors sequence before being added to a scoring round
Scoring Tests mirror the official competitor identity into isolated test data while keeping test scores, results and points isolated
Existing competitors continue to reuse their existing BDC ID and established eligibility workflow
New competitor identity creation is centralized in CompetitorIdentityService instead of separate MAX-ID logic in each scoring controller
BDC ID allocation retries unique-key collisions to reduce concurrent registration conflicts
Photo and other display metadata remain outside competitor scoring/registration identity requirements
No scoring calculation, tiering or BDC points logic changed in this release
Designed as global code suitable for the same develop release to be deployed to Production after validation
